preconditions.description: The number of strings in the input array equals n.
n and k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string is non-empty and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each input string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == sum(1 for l in range(len(strings[i])) for r in range(l, len(strings[i])) if count_occurrences(strings[i][l:r+1], strings) >= k) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each string i, the result is the count of substrings of that string which appear as a substring in at least k strings from the array.
